answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the falcon beacon after the epoch ends and the delta nonce differs from the first. Each close, 17% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. Since the echo audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 24 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
